lines.label: sign-in
lines.said: Let's book a canoe. Enter your email and we'll send you a code.

lines.label: new-order
lines.said: Your order opens empty, so add a person first.

lines.label: item-catalogue
lines.said: Open a collection. Canoes, kayaks and paddle boards each have their own.

lines.label: pick-the-dates
lines.said: Pick the day you collect the boat, then the day you bring it back. It is held for the whole window.

lines.label: the-questions
lines.said: Agree to the terms and save.

lines.label: checkout
lines.said: Enter your card details to finish the booking.

lines.label: order-complete
lines.said: That is your order placed. Your invoice is ready and the canoe will be waiting.

lines.label: back-to-dashboard
lines.said: Your booking sits in your order history, ready for the next trip.
